teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: San Francisco takes the top spot at 9-1 and has won 3 straight, the latest a 35-10 win over the Vikings. The offense at +4.2 points is the engine, and Seattle visits in week 12.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville slips to #2 after a 23-18 loss to the Giants, though the offense is still their best unit at +1.6 points. The Titans, ranked #30, come to town next, with the model favoring Jacksonville by 16.1.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo jumps three spots to #3 on a 6-game winning streak, the latest a 26-9 win over the Dolphins. They hold the best strength of record, rank 1, and host the Chiefs next.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit has won 6 straight, most recently 31-21 over the Buccaneers, and moves up to #4. The offense at +3.1 points carries them, and the model likes them 3.8 points more than Vegas does.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams sat out this week on a bye and still dropped two spots to #5, even with a 4-game winning streak. Players ruled out cost them 1.1 points, but the Packers visit with the model favoring LA by 6.1.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle also drops two spots to #6 after a bye, with a rating that didn't move. The defense at +1.9 points is the strength, but the offense is barely above average at +0.1 points.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City climbs three spots to #7 behind a 34-7 win over the Cardinals. Injuries swung them +1.4 points, and a trip to Buffalo comes next.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago slid one spot to #8 despite a 21-13 win over the Saints, its 5th in a row. Next is a road game in Detroit, where the model sees them as 3.8-point underdogs.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati lost 22-20 to the Commanders and falls a spot to #9. The defense at -0.7 points is the weak link, but the Saints are next with Cincinnati favored by 10.2.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver is 8-2 and has won 6 straight, the latest 38-24 over the Raiders, yet its point differential is just 26. That's why they sit at #10, with the third-best strength of record.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota fell two spots to #11 after a 35-10 loss to the 49ers. The offense at -2.0 points is the problem, while the defense at +1.9 points keeps them afloat.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston gained three spots to #12 after a 26-3 win over the Colts, helped by +1.2 points from injuries. They're only 4-6, and the model rates them 2.5 points lower than Vegas does.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay is 3-7 but ranked #13, thanks to a defense at +1.3 points. They lost 31-21 to the Lions, and the Panthers are next with the Bucs favored by 5.0.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay used its bye week and slipped one spot to #14. The point differential is only 5, and a trip to face the Rams comes next.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England used a bye at 5-5 and holds at 15. With a differential of -21 they're still 54 percent to make the playoffs, and the Chargers are next with the Patriots favored by 3.4.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas jumped three spots to #16 on a 51-30 win over the Titans, with injuries adding 2.0 points. The defense at -2.2 points remains a real problem.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington beat Cincinnati 22-20 and stays at 17. At 4-5-1 they're 26 percent for the playoffs, with the Cardinals next as 4.9-point favorites.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina holds at #18 after beating the Ravens 35-33 at home. At 5-5, they have a 50 percent chance to win the division and visit Tampa Bay next.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: New York beat the Jaguars 23-18 and rises two spots to #19, now 6-3-1. The model rates them 2.1 points lower than Vegas does, and the quarterback situation costs them 1.0 points.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta stays at #20 after a bye, having lost 3 straight and sitting at 3-7. The offense at -2.1 points is the issue, and Minnesota is next.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore has lost 6 straight, including a 35-33 loss to the Panthers, yet still moved up two spots to #21. The model rates them 3.0 points lower than Vegas does.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh drops six spots to #22, the biggest fall this week, after a 19-16 loss to the Eagles. The quarterback situation cost them 2.6 points.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland used its bye week and dipped one spot to #23. The offense at -2.5 points is the weak spot, but the Raiders are up next with Cleveland favored by 5.1.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans leaps five spots to #24 despite a 21-13 loss to the Bears, as injuries added 3.0 points. They're 3-7, and Cincinnati is a tough next stop.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets beat the Chargers 27-24 and edge up to #25. They're 3-8, but face the Dolphins next and are favored by 1.0.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: Los Angeles is 1-9 with a point differential of -98, after losing 27-24 to the Jets. The offense at -2.5 points is the biggest hole.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis fell three spots to #27 after a 26-3 loss to the Texans. The quarterback situation cost them 1.7 points, and they host the Giants as 0.7-point underdogs.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia beat the Steelers 19-16 and gains two spots to #28. The quarterback situation sits 3.5 points below their usual, and the offense is at -1.8 points.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas rises three spots to #29 despite losing 3 straight, the latest 38-24 to the Broncos. The model rates them 2.8 points lower than Vegas does.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee has lost 4 straight, the latest 51-30 to the Cowboys, and falls to #30 at 1-9. Next up is Jacksonville, which the model favors by 16.1.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona fell four spots to 31 after a 34-7 loss at Kansas City, its third straight. The point differential is -132 and the defense is -1.3 points.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is last at #32 after a 26-9 loss to the Bills, its 4th straight. At 1-9, they'll host the Jets as 1.0-point underdogs.
